description: This file defines the interface for handling mailmap data in Git, including function declarations for reading and clearing mailmap files or blobs, and for mapping user emails and names.

methods.name: read_mailmap_file
methods.description: Reads a mailmap file into the provided string_list structure with specified flags.

methods.name: read_mailmap_blob
methods.description: Reads mailmap data from a blob into the string_list structure.

methods.name: read_mailmap
methods.description: Initializes or loads the mailmap into the string_list.

methods.name: clear_mailmap
methods.description: Clears or resets the mailmap data in the provided string_list.

methods.name: map_user
methods.description: Maps a user's email and name based on the mailmap, updating the provided buffers.
